title: Change every item
summary: Ruby: Change every item. Multiply each item by 3.
introduction: map makes a new array from the result of a block for each item.

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.
map collects 4 and 6 from its block. join inserts the comma and space.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: map returns a new array; it does not replace the old one.
